project.name: universal-ai-context-layer-demo
project.summary: A context compiler that generates and validates AI-consumable project context.

project_goals: Keep AGENTS.md and related context outputs aligned with repository changes.
Preserve human-authored decisions when generated analysis is refreshed.
current_tasks: Improve context-source ingestion and drift validation.

decisions.title: Support AGENTS.md
decisions.rationale: Compile an established repository instruction format instead of replacing it.

constraints: Never overwrite a root AGENTS.md without an explicit force flag.
ai_instructions: Run context checks before publishing compiled outputs.

agent_roles.name: Coordinator Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Maintains priorities and delegates scoped work.

agent_roles.name: Coding Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Implements current tasks within recorded constraints.

agent_roles.name: Reviewer Agent
agent_roles.responsibility: Validates changes against goals and decisions.
